introduction.title: About KaiSource
introduction.paragraph1: Founded in 2014, KaiSource (KaiYuanShe) is a volunteer-led open source community built on contribution, consensus, and co-governance. We are vendor-neutral, non-profit, and focused on the public good. Our work connects China with the global open source community and helps build a healthy, lasting ecosystem.
introduction.paragraph2: KaiSource works with open source communities, universities, companies, public organizations, and government teams. We were the first organization from China to join the Open Source Initiative as an affiliate member.
introduction.paragraph3: Since 2016, we have hosted the China Open Source Conference (COSCon), published the China Open Source Annual Report, and helped launch programs that recognize open source contributors across China.
